podcast.title: Bee Gees' Pre-Disco Genre
podcast.body: The Bee Gees were known as a blue-eyed soul band before disco and their involvement with "Saturday Night Fever" revived their careers and made them superstars. "They were a blue-eyed soul band long before disco and jive-talking revived their careers before a Saturday Night Fever."

podcast.title: Hall & Oates as Premiere Act
podcast.body: Daryl Hall and John Oates became the premiere blue-eyed soul act of their day, topping both pop and R&B charts with their hit "I Can't Go For That." "I've chronicled how the duo of Darryl Hall and John Oates became the premiere blue-eyed soul act of their day, topping both the pop and R&B charts with I Can't Go For That."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: The Righteous Brothers as Duo
podcast.body: The Righteous Brothers are identified as a "Blue-eyed Soul Duo," known for their definitive version of "Unchained Melody." "The definitive version was issued by Blue-eyed Soul Duo, the Righteous Brothers."
